scope.sharing: Shared art confirms exterior appearance only. GPU/CPU temperatures, live RPM, load, power consumption and chip specifications are never inherited.
scope.unknowns: Unknown facts stay null. Empty external-power groups mean explicitly confirmed absence. Fan blade counts cover reviewed visible front rotors.
